operations.message: Insert key=10: hash(10) = 10 % 5 = 0 → bucket 0. Empty chain — inserted at head.
Insert key=6: hash(6) = 6 % 5 = 1 → bucket 1. No collision.
Insert key=3: hash(3) = 3 % 5 = 3 → bucket 3. No collision.
Insert key=20: hash(20) = 20 % 5 = 0 → bucket 0. ALREADY OCCUPIED by key=10!
HASH COLLISION: key=20 hashes to bucket 0 (same as key=10). Chaining appends c1 after c0.
Separate chaining resolves it: c0→c1 linked. Bucket 0 chain length = 2.
Insert key=30: hash(30) = 30 % 5 = 0 → bucket 0 AGAIN. Third collision in the same bucket!
HASH COLLISION #2: key=30 also maps to bucket 0. Chain now has 3 elements. Lookup degrades to O(n) for this bucket.
Chain is now c0→c1→c2. Performance warning: bucket 0 has load factor 3/5 = 0.6 — rehashing recommended.
